svg.title: iOS · Project photos · fullscreen viewer · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/CapturePhotoGrid.swift (CaptureFrameViewer), a fullScreenCover from the CapturePhotoGrid sheet. Swipe pages through one project's frames via TabView(.page) with indexDisplayMode .never — the "3 of 184" counter replaces the page dots. The frame is decoded by ProjectPreviewImage (App/ProjectMedia.swift) at 2560px with EXIF orientation applied, scaledToFit, so a 3:4 still letterboxes against black — and rendered through the project's colour grade when it has one, so the pager shows what the project card shows. Status bar is hidden; the bars respect the safe area (top 59 / bottom 34). Save to Photos is per frame and saves what is on screen: with a grade set it writes a graded JPEG (AppModel.saveGradedAsset), and with an untouched grade the frame's own bytes, so a DNG stays a DNG. State is keyed by frame index, so paging off a saved photo does not mark the next one saved: idle "Save to Photos" (accent capsule) → "Saving…" → "Saved to Photos" with a checkmark (capsule drops to white 18%, control disabled) → "Retry save" with the error above the capsule in red. Both bars carry a black 35% scrim, which is invisible against the letterboxed black backdrop — the rects are drawn as #000 here so their geometry is still specified.
